notes: Round-2 worldwide search for business barter / trade exchanges and WIR/Sardex-style B2B complementary-currency circuits not already in the live Trade Exchange Finder directory (55 listings after the 15 additions of 24 Nov 2026). Compared against GitHub main data/exchanges.json (count 55) and against the 23 Nov 2026 first-pass candidate/exclusion file. Values are taken only from public pages and directories checked on 24 Nov 2026 (America/New_York). Fields are null when a figure was not published. cash_fee_percent is set only when a source states a single percentage; more complex fee language is in fees_notes. Previously excluded names (KORP/France Barter, Barteos, Trade Euro, software vendors, corporate-barter firms) were not re-proposed. Circuito Linx, Circuito Venetex, Abrex and United Economy are flagged in their descriptions as complementary-currency / mutual-credit networks rather than classic North American trade exchanges. This file is research only; nothing has been written to the production database or the site repo.

candidates.name: BarterPay
candidates.description: BarterPay is a Canadian business barter exchange headquartered in Stoney Creek, Ontario, with franchise-style local communities across many provinces. Member businesses sell spare capacity or inventory into the network for Barter Credits that can be spent with other members nationwide. The company also promotes optional charitable donations of credits. This is proposed as one national listing, not a separate listing for each local BarterPay community.
candidates.fees_notes: A BarterPay promotional page for Brandon, Manitoba states an initial membership fee of $300 and a $15 monthly fee, and advertised a limited-time waiver of the initial fee plus the first three monthly payments. That page uses placeholder dates (XXXX) for the offer deadline and a chamber event, so the figures should be treated as published but possibly stale. No cash transaction-commission percentage was found on the official pages checked.
candidates.member_count_notes: The homepage states 'Join over 4000 business owners who are already making the smart choice to barter…'. This is the company's own marketing figure, not an audited headcount.
candidates.evidence: Live official site describing a closed-loop B2B barter network, with published contact details: 1040 South Service Rd., Suite 102, Stoney Creek, ON L8E 6G3, hello@barterpay.ca, toll-free 1.866.777.0660 and local 905.777.0660. The official news page has many dated 2026 posts, the latest titled 'The Invisible Foundation: Sustaining Your Team’s Mental Health' (20 April 2026), plus a 13 June 2025 'Meet BART' announcement (image uploaded under /wp-content/uploads/2025/09/). The locations page lists local BarterPay communities across Canada. Direct curl from this research environment received HTTP 403; the pages were read successfully via an HTTP fetch.

candidates.name: Art of Barter
candidates.description: Art of Barter is an independent trade exchange serving small businesses primarily in the Greater Chicagoland area. Members buy and sell with barter dollars; the company acts as a record keeper and clearinghouse and charges cash transaction fees plus a monthly service fee. It is distinct from already-listed IMS Barter, which operates a Chicago Barter brand after earlier Midwest acquisitions.
candidates.fees_notes: The Terms of Use (effective 18 September 2025) state that revenue comes from a cash transaction fee on barter transactions and a monthly service fee for maintaining member accounts. No specific percentage or dollar amounts were published on the pages checked.
candidates.member_count_notes: The About page says the company 'provides barter brokerage services to approximately 1,500 small business clients located primarily in the Greater Chicagoland area' and has 'negotiated in excess of $160 million in barter transactions for its members since beginning operation in 1992.'
candidates.evidence: Live official site with exchange content and a published Contact page at 609 E. Chicago St., Elgin, IL 60120, (847) 214-5656 (fax 847-214-5657). The public Cloudflare-protected email on the official pages decodes to info@artofbarter.com. Terms of Use are dated effective 18 September 2025 and describe Art of Barter as a barter exchange and third-party record keeper. The About page names Ron Szekeres as founder and president and John Hora as vice president, and says the company was formed in November 1991 and acquired by Szekeres and Hora in February 1995. Art of Barter does not appear on the IRTA or NATE directories checked on 24 November 2026.

candidates.name: Oklahoma Barter Exchange
candidates.description: Oklahoma Barter Exchange is an independently owned Tulsa trade exchange. Members trade goods and services through the network without cash. The company says it previously operated under the Business Exchange name and adopted the current name in 2021. It is distinct from the already-listed ITEX franchise offices that serve Tulsa and other Oklahoma and Missouri markets.
candidates.member_count_notes: The official site states it is 'a trade group of over 500 members' and 'the largest independently owned trade exchange in Oklahoma with over 20 years of successful trading in and around Tulsa.' These are the company's own figures.
candidates.evidence: Live official site with exchange content, a member marketplace, and published contact details: 5970 E 31st St. Suite P, Tulsa, OK 74135, (918) 628-1929 and (918) 619-6877, info@oklahomabarterexchange.com (also present as a Cloudflare-protected address on the contact page). The About page names Verna Claybrook as president and Alan Elias as president emeritus, and says the operation was renamed from Business Exchange to Oklahoma Barter Exchange in 2021. The site footer shows Copyright © 2026; a copyright year alone is not treated as sufficient. Third-party corroboration is an AllEvents listing for an 'OK Barter Exchange Christmas Barter Fair' organized by Oklahoma Barter Exchange on Saturday, 5 December 2026, at 2909 S Sheridan Rd, Tulsa. Search-index snippets for the same URL still carried a 6 December 2025 title, so the listing may have been updated from a 2025 event; no official first-party event page was found. Classified LIKELY ACTIVE because the 2025–2026 dated evidence is a third-party event listing rather than an official news post. The exchange is not on the IRTA or NATE directories checked on 24 November 2026.

candidates.name: iTrade Pay
candidates.description: iTrade Pay is a Phoenix-based membership trade exchange, formerly Value Card Alliance / Value Card Trade and rebranded nationally as iTrade Pay in 2019. Members trade goods and services for trade dollars through the iTrade Pay platform and brokers. The company also lists Tucson and Flagstaff market numbers and markets iTrade Pay barter software; this is proposed as one exchange listing, not a software-vendor listing and not a second Arizona listing for each city page. It is distinct from already-listed iTrade Colorado, Arizona Trade Exchange (Mesa), and Tradesource (Phoenix).
candidates.member_count_notes: The About page claims access to 'over 36,000 businesses.' The FAQ claims 'over 150 exchanges, 40,000 plus members, and more than $400 million in goods and services available.' Those figures appear to describe a broader affiliate or software-connected network, not a verified Phoenix-only headcount, and were not used as a local member count.
candidates.evidence: Live official site with exchange content and published contacts: corporate office 23335 N. 18th Dr., #124, Phoenix, AZ 85027, info@itradepay.com, local 602-308-0385 and toll-free 833-508-7233; additional numbers for Tucson (520-325-9914) and Flagstaff (928-851-7335). The official 'iTrade Pay 2026 Holiday Extravaganza' page advertises a Saturday, 21 November 2026, 8am–3pm holiday trade show with 300+ booths. That date was three days before this check (24 November 2026). The contact page names Christie Acevedo as president (ca@valuecardtrade.com). A caveat: the homepage still advertises a 'free $100 spending credit when you register by December 31st, 2022,' so some marketing copy is stale, but the dated 2026 event page is first-party evidence of current activity. iTrade Pay is not on the IRTA or NATE directories checked on 24 November 2026.

candidates.name: Circuito Linx
candidates.description: Circuito Linx is a Lombardy B2B commercial-credit (complementary-currency) circuit operated by Circuito Lombardia S.r.l. Member companies and professionals buy and sell using Linx credits pegged at 1 Linx = 1 euro, including an interest-free credit line repaid by selling to other members. This is a Sardex-style mutual-credit network, not a classic North American trade exchange, and it is distinct from already-listed Sardex (Sardinia) and BexB (Brescia).
candidates.fees_notes: The site emphasizes a 0% interest credit line. No cash commission or membership-fee amounts were found on the pages checked.
candidates.evidence: Live official site describing multilateral barter / commercial-credit trading, with published contacts: Circuito Lombardia S.r.l., Via Isonzo, 15, 20847 Albiate (MB), P.IVA 03528430139, info@circuitolinx.net, tel. 0362 1637823. The official 2026 events calendar lists member events on 27 May 2026 (Devero Hotel, Cavenago Brianza), 10 July 2026 (Palazzo di Tecniche Nuove, Milan), and 27 November 2026 (E-Work Arena, Busto Arsizio), and gives eventi@circuitolinx.net as the events address.

candidates.name: Circuito Venetex
candidates.description: Circuito Venetex is the Veneto commercial-credit circuit operated by Circuito Venetex S.r.l. Members trade using Venetex credits and can access interest-free spending credit repaid by selling inside the network. It is part of the wider Italian circuit family that includes already-listed Sardex, and its own magazine coverage describes joint events with Sardex. Proposed as a separate regional listing because it has its own legal entity, website, and territory.
candidates.fees_notes: The site advertises access to interest-free credit (scoperto a tasso zero). No cash commission or membership-fee amounts were found on the pages checked.
candidates.member_count_notes: The homepage says the network includes 'oltre 800' businesses and professionals in Veneto and 'più di 10.000 sul territorio nazionale.' The national figure appears to refer to the wider Italian commercial-credit group, not Venetex-only membership; 800 is the published Veneto figure.
candidates.evidence: Live official site with published contacts: Circuito Venetex S.r.l., Via Sesta Strada, 8, 35129 Padova, info@circuitovenetex.net, 049 8649108, P.IVA 04968990285. An official magazine article describes a 5 May 2026 event at Villa Bornello (Treviso) that Venetex organized with Sardex and NATIVA on Società Benefit and complementary currency; the article is written in the past tense and a related image was stored under a 2026/05 path. A LinkedIn post also documented an 8 April 2025 Venetex aperipranzo in Padova.

candidates.name: Abrex
candidates.description: Abrex is an Abruzzo commercial-credit circuit operated by Abrex S.r.l. Member businesses exchange goods and services using the circuit’s complementary credits and can access interest-free credit. The site identifies Franco Contu, a co-founder of already-listed Sardex, as vice president of Abrex, so this is a Sardex-related regional circuit with its own company, site, and territory.
candidates.fees_notes: The site advertises interest-free credit. No cash commission or membership-fee amounts were found on the pages checked.
candidates.evidence: Live official site describing a commercial-credit circuit, with published contacts: Abrex S.r.l., legal seat Viale D’Annunzio, 64, Vasto (CH), info@circuitoabrex.net, +39 0871 564511. An official news post dated 5 March 2025 invited members to a 13 March 2025 event at Via Pietro Nenni 296/298, San Giovanni Teatino (CH), to present new circuit services and a new office. The homepage also names Franco Contu as co-founder of Sardex and vice president of Abrex.

candidates.name: United Economy
candidates.description: United Economy is a Dutch cooperative sustainability network (United Economy Coöperatie / Circulair Geld Nederland) in which businesses and individuals try to buy from one another through a shared trading environment. Members may optionally use a 'circular account' so payments stay inside the value-driven economy, and the cooperative also mentions interest-free cooperative credit. This is not a classic membership trade exchange; it is a B2B/B2C complementary-currency and sustainable purchasing network and should be flagged as that type if listed.
candidates.member_count_notes: The homepage says more than 700 large and small values-driven (SME) companies and organizations have already joined. Individuals can also participate. This is the organization's own figure.
candidates.evidence: Live official site with published contacts: Oudegracht 42, 3511 AR Utrecht, email given as 'info @ unitedeconomy.nl' (spaces to be removed), KvK 74923072, VAT 8600.74.870.B.01, legal name United Economy Coöperatie / Circulair Geld Nederland. No phone number was found on the contact page. The official agenda lists 2025 events including Donut Festival (16 May 2025) and the United Economy annual event (6 October 2025), and 2026 events including Impact Trade Fair (9 April 2026, Jaarbeurs Utrecht), Positive Finance Day 2026 (10 June 2026, Driebergen), a 22 June 2026 Utrecht meeting, and a 13 July 2026 Zomeratelier at Landgoed Zonheuvel, Doorn. The 'Wat we doen' page describes the optional circular account used for payments inside the network.

candidates.name: Barter Japan
candidates.description: Barter Japan (バータージャパン株式会社) is a Tokyo-based membership barter community for business owners and freelancers, founded in 2009. Members exchange goods and services using Barter Points (BP) rather than cash. The company explicitly says BP is not a cryptocurrency. It also holds frequent in-person and online business-matching meetings in Tokyo, Koriyama and on Zoom. No public email address was found; the official site publishes a Tokyo phone and fax and a contact form.
candidates.joining_fee: 110,000 yen (tax excluded) for companies 1–100 in the current second recruitment; 330,000 yen from the 101st company
candidates.fees_notes: The official membership-guidance page (tax-excluded prices) states a joining fee of 110,000 yen for up to 100 companies in the second recruitment, then 330,000 yen per company after that, plus 400,000 yen in loaned joining credits. A barter fee of 3.3% of BP used is billed monthly to regular members, or 11% to pre-members, together with membership dues. The dues amount itself is referred to but was not readable as a figure (the fee table on the page did not render as text). A one-year joining-fee refund policy is also published, subject to conditions.
candidates.member_count_notes: The joining-fee note said the second recruitment was 'currently 86 companies' of a 100-company tier. That is a fee-tier figure, not a verified total membership, and was not used as a headcount. The group has held at least 190 numbered business-matching meetings, which implies a longer-running membership community.
candidates.evidence: Live official site with company profile: バータージャパン株式会社, founded July 2009, head office 〒160-0022 Tokyo, Shinjuku 1-24-7-408, plus Saitama and Yokohama branches; TEL 03-5379-3965, FAX 03-3355-8205; representative director Kazufumi Nozaki (野崎 一文). Official 2026 news includes a 6 October 2026 notice that monthly dues and barter fees can now be paid by credit card, and meeting-schedule updates. The activities calendar lists many 2026 meetings, including the 190th business-matching meeting on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, 18:00–21:00 at 草思庵チャング in Shinagawa, Tokyo — one week before this check.
